verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a SaaS billing platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to. The Compass MCP server lets external agents like Claude Desktop or Cursor reach Recurly, and churn propensity is a machine-learning scoring feature; both are adjacent capabilities from other stories and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
